content.title: Koyo 6306-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 30mm Bore x 72mm OD x 19mm Width, Metal Shielded
content.short_description: Koyo 6306-ZZ single-row deep groove ball bearing with metal shields, 30mm bore, 72mm OD, 19mm width. Static load rating 16 kN, limiting speed 13000 rpm.
content.long_description:
The Koyo 6306-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing with a 30 mm bore, 72 mm outer diameter, and 19 mm width, matching standard 6306-series envelope dimensions. It is fitted with ZZ metal shields on both sides, providing a physical barrier against dust and coarse contaminants while retaining factory-applied lubricant.

Load and speed data place this bearing at a static load rating (C0) of 16 kN and a limiting speed of 13000 rpm. Maximum operating temperature is rated at 120°C, which should be checked against lubricant limits and application duty cycle when specifying for continuous-run equipment.

The 6306-ZZ bore and OD combination is common across general industrial rotating equipment, including pumps, gearboxes, electric motors, and conveyor rollers where a shielded (non-contact) seal is acceptable for the operating environment. Metal shields offer lower running friction than contact rubber seals but provide less protection against fine particulate or liquid ingress, so application environment should be evaluated accordingly.

Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances, mounting orientation, and lubrication compatibility before installation. This bearing does not include contact seals; if the application requires sealing against liquids or fine dust, a 2RS-sealed alternative should be considered instead.
